body:
Brick level boxes get sparse per-cell HP (PARENA paper_fragment_mod + interact_falloff + new shankpit/brick_rules.prn); destroyed cells become real holes via piece re-expression into physics custom-level slots; server-authoritative PACKET_BRICK_STATE (idempotent, repeated, rotating refresh); debris, decal cleanup, pause-menu BRICK DEBRIS toggle; TUTORIAL_BRICK registry example level. make test-brick (ASan/UBSan, fuzz, overflow rollback, real-engine integration) + make brick-e2e (real server + packet clients) in tests.yml, CI green, SHANKPIT 5deecdf/5d79dd8, PARENA 6b43ef8, IDUNA 4ce805a. Live Xvfb-verified. Limits: NOCK/custom levels only, melee does not hurt brick, 900-piece budget per level.

⚓ ☃
